description:
Real fossils, dug up layer by layer from 12 million to 550 million years down, and every deeper layer hides a scarier story: wasps inside fossil flies, a snake with a lizard with a bug inside it, a parasite caught still clinging to its host. Doug digs the whole shaft and visits each find on its last day.

Which layer would you have stopped digging at? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
